name: stem-player
description: Personal, non-commercial local stem separation app (Phase 1: separation pipeline only)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n next,electron -c blue,magenta "npm:next:dev" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3000 && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron ."
scripts.start: npm run next:build && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron .
